title: Analysis code for: Amygdala subregion atrophy in Parkinson's disease is associated with visual hallucinations and cognitive impairment
description: Python analysis code reproducing the statistical results, tables and figures of the manuscript, using harmonised FreeSurfer amygdala nucleus volumes and clinical data from the Parkinson's Progression Markers Initiative. This research was funded in whole or in part by Aligning Science Across Parkinson's (027449) through the Michael J. Fox Foundation for Parkinson's Research (MJFF).
